tasks.title: Record a walk-in enquiry
tasks.goal: Record an in-person enquiry so it can be followed up or booked.
tasks.before: Have the caller or representative details, the intended client and the clinic ready.
tasks.success: One contact records the enquiry and its clinic. An enquiry does not require a booking.
tasks.trouble: If Walk-in is not available, ask the administrator to check the configured channels. Do not substitute an unrelated live channel.
tasks.title_vi: Ghi nhận khách đến trực tiếp
steps: Open carejiox.com and sign in with your own account. Expand CRM in the left menu and open Contacts.
Choose New Contact. Select Walk-in as the contact channel.
Enter the details requested on the form. If the person is a representative, identify the client separately; use an existing client record where appropriate.
Choose the correct clinic and record the service interest or condition information supplied by the caller. Complete the required fields.
Save the contact. Return to Contacts and search for the entry using the caller details.
Open the saved entry and confirm that Walk-in and the intended clinic are retained. Continue to Book only if a visit is agreed.

If any line is unexpected, retain the booking and invoice references and ask Finance or the pricing administrator to investigate before posting or collecting.
tasks.warning: Use the approved tariff and tax settings for the actual visit. The invoice total and the remaining balance are different values.

operations.question: A visit moves to a different day. What should you check?
options: The new time, active staff assignment, history and pricing conditions
Create a second visit and leave the old one active
operations.explanation: Reschedule the existing visit and check staff, history and any changed pricing conditions.

crm.question: A relative calls again for an existing client. What should you do?
options: Create a new client for every enquiry
Create a new contact and link the existing client
crm.explanation: A new enquiry has its own contact. The same client record can have several contacts and bookings.

clinical.question: When should you use Start Service?
clinical.explanation: Accepting confirms the assignment; Start Service records the actual beginning of the visit.

finance.question: A client pays 80,000 VND against a 180,000 VND invoice. What should remain due?
finance.explanation: Record only the money received. The unpaid remainder is 100,000 VND.

owner.question: A staff member needs access to their assigned catchment. What is the correct approach?
options: Review the approved job, catchment and staff linkage
owner.explanation: Use individual accounts and the approved role and catchment; do not widen access to bypass a problem.

crm.title: Follow an enquiry through to a booking
steps: Ask your trainer for a synthetic caller and an existing practice client in the training clinic.
Create a new contact and link that existing client; keep the caller and client distinct.
Schedule a follow-up with a reason and time. Reopen the contact and find the follow-up.
Create the agreed booking from the enquiry. Check the contact, client and booking links with your trainer.
crm.check: There is one new enquiry linked to the existing client, and the booking can be traced back to that enquiry.

operations.title: Reschedule an assigned visit
steps: Ask your trainer for an unstarted practice booking in your catchment. Use the training clinic.
Record its original visit time, assigned staff and quoted total.
Reschedule it to the agreed time and check staff availability. Replace staff only if authorised.
Reopen the booking and compare its new date, assignment and pricing conditions with the intended change.
operations.check: The booking is in the correct catchment, has the agreed time and available staff, and any pricing change has been reviewed.

clinical.title: Complete a practice visit
steps: Use a synthetic visit assigned to you in the training clinic; ask your trainer to confirm it is safe to complete.
Review the client and visit details, accept the assignment and use Start Service when the practice visit begins.
Enter a practice note containing no real patient information and save it. Reopen it to check the saved text.
Answer the closing questions, complete the visit and review the final status with your trainer.
clinical.check: The correct visit has a saved note, the required closing answers and the expected completed status.

finance.title: Record a part payment and check the remainder
steps: Ask your trainer for an authorised practice invoice of 180,000 VND in the training clinic. Do not send money or a real payment request.
Record the agreed practice payment of 80,000 VND using the training payment method.
Reopen the invoice and compare total, paid amount and amount due.
Review the payment reference and accounting history with your trainer, then follow the training clinic’s cleanup procedure.
finance.check: The invoice total is 180,000 VND, the recorded payment is 80,000 VND and the remaining amount due is 100,000 VND.

owner.title: Review a staff member’s access
steps: Ask your trainer for a practice staff account and the approved role, catchment and employee linkage in the training clinic.
Open Users & Roles and compare the account with that access plan.
With the trainer, verify one permitted task and one record outside the assigned catchment.
Record any mismatch for the administrator. Keep the account’s permissions limited to its intended job.
owner.check: The staff member can do the assigned work and cannot read records outside their permitted scope.
